analyzed_vuln.description: `frame_get_usermeta` trusts the trailer-provided `usermeta_len` and copies that many bytes from `frame->sdata + trailer_offset + FRAME_TRAILER_USERMETA_OFFSET` without validating that the requested range is within `frame_len`/input buffer bounds. Only the 4-byte length field location is bounds-checked, not the subsequent payload. A forged frame can set a huge positive `usermeta_len`, causing out-of-bounds read in `memcpy` (crash seen at line 1114).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In `decompress_frame_fuzzer`, attacker-controlled bytes are passed directly to `blosc2_schunk_open_sframe` -> `blosc2_frame_to_schunk` -> `frame_get_usermeta`. Trigger requires an in-memory frame (`frame->sdata != NULL`) with a parseable header/trailer so execution reaches usermeta parsing, and a trailer `usermeta_len` value > remaining bytes after `trailer_offset + FRAME_TRAILER_USERMETA_OFFSET`. Because no upper-bound check enforces `offset + usermeta_len <= frame_len`, memcpy reads past the heap buffer.
